class.name: MathJax

method.name: get_error_message
method.description: Returns what went wrong in the last [method tex_to_svg] call, such as [code]Missing close brace[/code], or an empty string if it succeeded.

method.name: tex_to_svg
method.description: Returns an SVG image of the TeX math in [param tex], or an empty string if it couldn't be typeset; [method get_error_message] then tells why. With [param display] true, the formula is set on a line of its own, like [code]$$...$$[/code] in LaTeX: larger operators, with their limits above and below. Otherwise it's set to sit inside a line of text. All of MathJax's TeX packages are available, including [code]ams[/code], [code]physics[/code], [code]mhchem[/code] and [code]cancel[/code].
